description: This file implements configuration flag handling for the Cuttlefish project, including classes for managing system image directory flags, reading configuration presets from JSON files, and integrating with gflags for command-line options. It defines classes such as SystemImageDirFlagImpl, ConfigReader, and ConfigFlagImpl, and sets up dependency injection components for these features.

classes.name: SystemImageDirFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the SystemImageDirFlag interface, managing the system image directory flag.

classes.name: ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads and manages configuration presets from JSON files.

classes.name: ConfigFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ConfigFlag interface, managing the configuration preset selection and application.

classes.name: ConfigFlagPlaceholderImpl
classes.description: Placeholder implementation of ConfigFlag, used for dependency injection when the feature is disabled or not needed.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and applies configuration settings accordingly.

methods.name: ReadConfig
methods.description: Reads a specific configuration JSON file based on the preset name.

methods.name: ChooseConfig
methods.description: Selects a configuration preset by name, validating its existence.
